everythings.line: With boats and bells and beams and candy-appled everythings
stanza: Like ice cream floats and dreams, and I will fill your heart
With boats and bells and beams and candy-appled everythings
Bells and beams and candy-appled everythings
And we just can't have that, girl
'Cause it's a sad, lonesome, cold world
And a man needs a woman
And the sound of the rain
